name: Csengerújfalu (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of blue and yellow at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Csengerújfalu (a green, blue and red shield with ears of grain, a plough and a wheel) above a yellow scroll inscribed CSENGERÚJFALU.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
